scoring_justification: The paper’s headline claim is a relative ordering of formation energies across phases. T1 recompute is infeasible without the intermediate total_energies.json as a scored artifact; T2 consistency is not applicable. T3 structural inequalities directly capture the stability reversal and are robust to toolchain‑induced absolute shifts.

outputs.description: Computed heats of formation for pristine and doped CsSnI3 in the B-gamma and Y phases. The scoring verifies the relative ordering of formation energies across phases and doping conditions.

output_contract.notes: Scoring is based on structural ordering: for pristine, ΔH_F(Y) must be lower than ΔH_F(B-gamma); for Sb- and Bi-doped, ΔH_F(B-gamma) must be lower than ΔH_F(Y). Absolute values contribute only to a minor consistency check.

steps.description: Verify the three required formation‑energy orderings: pristine Y < B‑gamma, Sb‑doped B‑gamma < Y, Bi‑doped B‑gamma < Y.
